config.codigo: try { const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); const ws = process.cwd(); const dbPath = path.join(ws, '.opencorp/tasks.db'); if (!fs.existsSync(dbPath)) { console.log('SEM_TASKS_DB'); process.exit(0); } const Database = require('better-sqlite3'); const db = new Database(dbPath); const total = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM tasks').get().c; const pendentes = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM tasks WHERE coluna NOT IN ('feito', 'descartado')").get().c; console.log(`KANBAN_STATUS:total=${total},pendentes=${pendentes}`); } catch (e) { console.log('ERRO_KANBAN:' + e.message); }

config.ordem: Inspecione o estado do Kanban e dos registros recentes do workspace. Diagnostique bloqueios, organize as prioridades pendentes e registre um breve resumo operacional em registries/auditorias/.
